property.text: Sender pays effective_gas_fee and blob_gas_fee upfront before execution. process_transaction (SG-013) must deduct max gas fees from sender balance before message execution.

reachability.notes: If fees are not deducted upfront, the sender could spend the balance during execution and avoid paying gas fees.

property.severity_justification: Late fee deduction allows execution with insufficient funds, creating a fee-evasion exploit.
property.bug_bounty_notes: PoC must demonstrate a transaction executing without upfront fee deduction.

property.text: Unused gas must be refunded at effective_gas_price. process_transaction (SG-013) must refund gas_left * effective_gas_price to the sender after execution.

reachability.notes: If the refund uses an incorrect gas price (e.g., base fee instead of effective price, or a higher price), the sender receives incorrect refund amounts.

property.severity_justification: Incorrect refund amounts cause economic imbalance but do not directly compromise consensus. Over/under-refunding affects ETH supply accuracy.
property.bug_bounty_notes: PoC must demonstrate a transaction where the refund amount does not equal gas_left * effective_gas_price.

property.text: Miner/coinbase must receive only the priority fee portion. process_transaction (SG-013) must pay coinbase: tx_gas_used * (effective_gas_price - base_fee_per_gas). Base fee must be burned, not paid to the miner.

reachability.notes: If the coinbase receives the full effective gas price instead of just the priority fee, the base fee is not burned, undermining EIP-1559's deflationary mechanism.

property.severity_justification: Paying base fee to coinbase instead of burning it breaks EIP-1559 economics and prevents proper ETH supply management.
property.bug_bounty_notes: PoC must demonstrate coinbase receiving more than tx_gas_used * priority_fee_per_gas.

property.text: Accounts marked for deletion must be destroyed after transaction execution. process_transaction (SG-013) must destroy all accounts in accounts_to_delete set after message execution.

reachability.notes: SELFDESTRUCT marks accounts for deletion. If the deletion fails, state divergence occurs between spec and implementation.

property.severity_justification: Failure to delete accounts causes state trie divergence, leading to consensus failure on state root comparison.
property.bug_bounty_notes: PoC must demonstrate accounts surviving despite being in accounts_to_delete, causing state root mismatch.

property.text: Beacon roots system transaction must execute before any user transactions. apply_body (SG-011) must call process_unchecked_system_transaction(BEACON_ROOTS_ADDRESS) as the first operation.

reachability.notes: If beacon roots are written after user transactions, those transactions cannot access the expected beacon root data via the ring buffer. The ordering is protocol-mandated.

property.severity_justification: Incorrect ordering causes beacon root data to be unavailable during transaction execution, breaking EIP-4788 dependent contracts.
property.bug_bounty_notes: Must demonstrate beacon root unavailability during transaction execution due to ordering violation.

property.text: History storage system transaction must execute after beacon roots and before user transactions. apply_body (SG-011) must call process_unchecked_system_transaction(HISTORY_STORAGE_ADDRESS) as the second operation.

reachability.notes: History storage must be updated before user transactions to ensure correct historical data access.

property.severity_justification: Incorrect ordering causes stale history data during transaction execution, affecting contracts querying historical block hashes.
property.bug_bounty_notes: Must demonstrate history storage data inconsistency due to ordering violation.

property.text: Transactions must be processed in sequential order within a block. apply_body (SG-011) must process transactions in the order they appear in the block's transaction list.

reachability.notes: Out-of-order transaction processing would produce different state roots, receipts, and logs. The sequential ordering is a consensus invariant.

property.severity_justification: Out-of-order processing produces different state roots across clients, causing consensus failure.
property.bug_bounty_notes: Must demonstrate that reordered transaction processing produces a different state root.

property.text: Withdrawals must be processed after all transactions. apply_body (SG-011) must call process_withdrawals after all transactions have been processed.

reachability.notes: Processing withdrawals before all transactions would alter state during transaction execution, producing different state roots.

property.severity_justification: Premature withdrawal processing alters balances visible to transactions, causing state root divergence.
property.bug_bounty_notes: Must demonstrate state root difference when withdrawals are processed before all transactions.

property.text: General purpose requests must be processed last in block body. apply_body (SG-011) must call process_general_purpose_requests after withdrawals and all transactions.

reachability.notes: Request processing depends on the final state after all transactions and withdrawals. Premature processing would miss or include incorrect requests.

property.severity_justification: Incorrect request ordering produces different requests_hash, causing consensus failure.
property.bug_bounty_notes: Must demonstrate requests_hash mismatch due to incorrect processing order.

property.text: Request types must be appended in ascending order: deposits, then withdrawals, then consolidations. process_general_purpose_requests (SG-012) must assemble requests in this exact order.

reachability.notes: The request ordering determines the requests_hash. An attacker can craft transactions that generate deposit logs and trigger withdrawal/consolidation requests. If the ordering is violated, the requests_hash will differ between implementations.

property.severity_justification: Incorrect request ordering produces a different requests_hash, causing the block to be rejected or causing consensus splits.
property.bug_bounty_notes: PoC must demonstrate a block where request ordering affects the requests_hash.
